rows.requirement: Use the current HMLR INSPIRE release and record publication date, local-authority file name, byte size and checksum.
Read the GML directly or convert once with field-name and geometry-count reconciliation; retain original GML checksum.
Confirm source coordinates are British National Grid and preserve the declared CRS before any transformation.
Do not round-trip HMLR geometry through an unspecified WGS84 conversion; use the definitive grid transformation and retain software and grid versions.
Capture the unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID for every candidate polygon and never use display order as identity.
Do not assume one polygon per title; preserve all separate polygons that may relate to the same registered title.
Open INSPIRE matching is labelled freehold-subset coverage; absence is not treated as proof of unregistered land because leasehold and other tenures may be absent.
Load relevant neighbouring local-authority files and deduplicate repeated polygons using INSPIRE ID plus normalized geometry fingerprint.
Require non-empty valid polygonal geometry; repair attempts must be recorded and area or topology changes quantified.
Use contains or covers in EPSG:27700 against the validated canonical point; retain all candidates when the point lies on an edge or in overlapping polygons.
Multiple covering polygons are not resolved by nearest centroid or smallest area alone; hold until identity or title evidence reconciles the candidates.
Record how the canonical parcel ID maps to INSPIRE ID and, when licensed data is available, Poly_ID and Title_No.
When National Polygon data is used, preserve Poly_ID, Title_No, INSERT, UPDATE, Vers_No and Rec_Status and reject deleted or superseded records under the product rules.
Every open INSPIRE or index-polygon result must state indicative position and extent and must not claim the legal boundary line.
State that the extent of land in a registered title cannot be established from INSPIRE polygons alone and requires title-plan/register evidence.
Use exact or determined-boundary language only with title-specific evidence matched to the same identity chain.
The inward raster sampling buffer is an engineering contamination control and is not reported as legal-boundary tolerance.
Publish every candidate polygon, spatial predicate result, identity field, geometry fingerprint and rejection or hold reason.
Retain the required HMLR Crown copyright/database-right and Ordnance Survey polygon geometry attribution for reused INSPIRE data.
Publish a parcel polygon association only when release, checksum, CRS, identity, deduplication, validity, spatial predicate and semantics gates pass; otherwise keep boundary fields null.
